attributes.action: Students shouldn't have to go to school in extreme weather warnings
attributes.background: In England it is currently 38 degrees and a red weather warning. It is too hot to learn. In the winter there was a red wind warning. It was windy and dangerous. I think if there is a RED weather warning kids should not have to go to school

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023
